trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' RETURN DISTINCT p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' OR p.birth_date = '1973-11-25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date IN ['1973/11/25', '1973-11-25', '11/25/1973', '11/25/73', 'November 25, 1973'] RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
